name: homie
description: A studio in a box on your own Cloudflare: set up a studio (one repository for games, music, videos and posts) with a setup status of your accounts and tools and a step-by-step checklist, plan each game in a short interview that becomes its Game Codex (a page in the game's own look that you can read and steer, kept up to date, with the build's progress on it), build with one agent or several in parallel, make multiplayer web games or make an existing single-player game multiplayer, give games sound effects and synthesized music made on your own computer for free, make songs and game scores with ElevenLabs Music on your own account, make covers and painted art with fal on your own account under a budget, give a game one coherent look as decisions you can steer and lock (a style board of three directions drawn by the game engine itself, free) with free CC0 3D models from Homie's starter library, your own models, generated props and rigged characters on your own fal account under a budget, animated characters (one skeleton standard, free CC0 clips retargeted onto every rig, idle, run, jump and actions with IK feet, springs and look-at), every asset licensed, checked for phones and shown in a lineup at true scale, playtest a game on a computer and a phone with measured checks and a blind review, make a game run faster on phones and computers with a measured loop (frame times, CPU per frame, time to playable, downloads, memory, netplay; one change at a time, kept only when it beats the noise and the game still passes its own check), tune how a move feels in a Game Lab (one take of your working tree beside the last commit on one clock, slowed down or a frame at a time, with its named phases, graphs and sliders that write the values you keep back into the game), make gameplay trailers and music videos (captured from your game, or generated with fal under a budget with receipts) and recordings of a page while a script drives it (Play and a few moves on your game, a site walkthrough, a demo), in real time with honest frames, run the studio's site (the same sections as homie.rocks in the studio's own look, an epic landing page for every game, news posts with feeds) and public rooms (up to 32 players a room, shareable from the play page) on its own Cloudflare account (free plan, no payment method), list it in the homie.rocks directory, read the studio's own stats (counts, never tracking), and run its live games from a back office (who is playing now, in-game announcements, kick and mute, close a room, players per room, and private / invite-only beta / public launch states with invite codes; the owner confirms anything that takes something away with one tap). In Claude Code (2.1.287 or later) a mod adds the studio's band above the prompt, a Studio pane (the build's progress with its latest frame, live rooms with the back office, games, stats, the Game Codex, the Game Lab's last checks, parallel parts), instant commands, an arcade pane that plays a live Homie game with strangers while Claude works, holds on protected files, deploys and spending past the budget, and secrets taken out of tool output; in Codex, Homie's hooks hold the same calls until you answer "proceed", and take secrets out of what Codex reads. In Grok Build the same hooks hold the same calls once you trust the plugin (grok plugin install with --trust). Make a game an app of its own: a desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux and a phone app for iOS and Android, the files Steam and the app stores accept for upload (their review, fees and rules are theirs), the same web game in a thin shell that still plays through your studio's site (no accounts, cloud saves or shop in the app yet). Tell Homie what got in the way, or what you love, in a short note you see word for word and send only with your yes. Beta.

interface.shortDescription: Studios for games, music and video on your own Cloudflare
interface.longDescription: Set up a studio as one repository (games, music, videos, posts) with a setup status of your accounts and tools and a checklist that never jumps ahead, plan each game in a short interview that becomes its Game Codex (a page in the game's own palette, fonts and art, kept up to date, with a live build status), build with one agent or several in parallel, make multiplayer web games, make an existing single-player web game multiplayer where strangers meet in public rooms (every browser renders, bots fill seats, rounds restart), give a game sound effects and a synthesized theme made on your own computer for free (measured, wired in, starting on the first touch), make songs and game scores with ElevenLabs Music on your own account, make a cover from a real frame of the game and painted art with fal on your own account under a budget, give a game one coherent look as decisions you can steer and lock (a style board of three directions drawn by the game engine itself, free; the decisions drawn in the Game Codex) with free CC0 3D models from Homie's starter library (Kenney, KayKit, Poly Haven, ambientCG, phone-sized), your own models, generated props (a concept in the locked style, then image-to-3D) and rigged characters (an A-pose concept, then image-to-3D with its auto-rig) on your own fal account under a budget with receipts, animated characters (a skeleton standard, free CC0 clips retargeted onto every character, one shared player with blends, IK feet, springs and look-at, and an Animation card of looping previews), every asset with its licence and credits, checked against phone budgets and shown in a lineup at true scale, playtest a game on a computer and a phone held both ways (first ten seconds, look, UI, real sound, a round, the owner control tests) with a blind review, make a game faster with a measured loop (frame times p50 and p95, CPU per frame for the host and a replica, time to playable, downloads, memory, netplay messages; each change measured against the build to beat in alternating runs, kept only when it is better beyond the noise and still passes the two-browser check, reverted otherwise, with a report), tune how a move feels in a Game Lab (one take of the working tree beside the last commit, frame by frame, with named phases, graphs New against Today and sliders that write kept values back into the game), make gameplay trailers and music videos (captured from your game, or generated with fal on your own account, under a budget with receipts) and recordings of a page while a script drives it (Play and a few moves on your game, a site walkthrough, a demo), in real time with honest frames, preview locally, deploy the studio's site to its own Cloudflare account on the free plan (no payment method; rooms of up to 32 players), list the games in the homie.rocks directory, read the studio's own stats, and run the live games from a back office (who is playing, announcements, kick and mute, closed rooms, invite-only betas and private games; the owner confirms what takes something away with one tap). Homie's hooks hold edits to protected files, deploys, Cloudflare changes and spending past the budget until you answer "proceed", and take secrets out of what Codex reads (trust them once in /hooks). In Grok Build the same hooks hold the same calls once you trust the plugin (grok plugin install with --trust). Tell Homie what got in the way, or what you love: Claude can offer once in a session to send the people who make Homie a short note, which you see word for word and send only with your yes. Beta: report issues at github.com/homie-rocks/homie/issues.
